blocks.text: A soft hyphen (U+00AD) marks where a long word may break. It draws nothing until the line ends there, and then it draws one hyphen; text extraction never returns it. pdfnative 1.8.0 fixed the rendering — earlier versions printed every soft hyphen as a permanent one. The CLI ships no hyphenation dictionary: the soft hyphens below were typed into the document.

In­ter­na­tion­al­i­sa­tion and an­ti­con­sti­tu­tion­nelle­ment are in­com­pre­hen­si­bly long words; elec­tro­en­ceph­a­lo­graph­i­cal­ly re­pro­duc­i­ble ty­pog­ra­phy de­pends on char­ac­ter­is­ti­cal­ly un­ob­tru­sive hy­phen­a­tion, par­tic­u­lar­ly in nar­row jus­ti­fied col­umns where in­ter­word spac­ing would oth­er­wise be­come dis­pro­por­tion­ate­ly con­spic­u­ous. layout.typography sets the document-wide rules: paragraphs may split across pages (splitParagraphs) but never leave fewer than three lines at the foot (orphans) or at the head (widows) of a page, and a heading stays with at least three lines of what follows. Two per-block keys refine them.
keepWithNext: true — this lead-in sentence is never the last thing on a page; it moves to the next page with the block it introduces:

items: a list, a table or a figure that needs its introduction;
a caption written before its illustration;
a question followed by its answer.

blocks.text: splittable: false — this paragraph is laid out in one piece even though splitParagraphs is on for the rest of the document. Use it for a legal clause, an address block, a short quotation or a code listing: anything a page break would damage. If it does not fit in what remains of the page, the whole paragraph moves to the next one. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi ut aliquip ex ea commodo consequat.

pdfnative render --inspect-layout prints the page and the position of every block without writing a PDF: the same pagination planner runs for the report and for the render, so the page map is the truth.
